label: Acoustic-Doppler velocity profiling
description: Determination of velocity as a function of distance or depth from Doppler shifts of returned acoustic signals.

label: Acoustic thermometry
description: Determination of temperature from an acoustic property such as the speed of sound.

label: Acoustic transit-time velocimetry
description: Determination of fluid velocity from differences in acoustic travel time along one or more propagation paths.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Aerodynamic particle sizing
description: Determination of particle size from aerodynamic response to an accelerating or classified flow.

label: Aerosol mass spectrometry
description: Mass-spectrometric determination of the composition or mass distribution of aerosol particles.

label: Amperometry
description: Electrochemical determination based on measurement of electrical current at a controlled electrode potential.
notes: General electrochemical method useful beyond the existing oxygen-specific polarographic entry.

label: Anemometry
description: Measurement of fluid velocity, particularly wind speed.

label: Atmometric evaporation measurement
description: Determination of evaporative water loss from a continuously wetted porous or fibrous surface by measuring the decrease in a connected water reservoir.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 10 "Measurement of evaporation" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Atmospheric radio-noise detection
description: Detection of lightning-generated radio-frequency electromagnetic pulses propagating through the atmosphere. Note: also referred to as atmospherics or sferics detection.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. III, Ch. 6 "Electromagnetic methods of lightning detection" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Automated image classification
description: Determination of an observed class or category from algorithmic analysis of image data.
notes: Candidate for automated cloud, weather, phenology, biological and surface observations; boundary with processing methods needs discussion.

label: Bimetallic actinography
description: Measurement and recording of broadband solar irradiance by a bimetallic pyranometric sensor whose differential heating produces mechanical deformation. Note: also referred to as a Robitzsch actinograph.
descriptionSource: WMO International Meteorological Vocabulary (WMO-No. 182), "Robitzsch actinograph"; WMO-No. 258, Guidelines for the Education and Training of Personnel in Meteorology, radiation-instrument section

label: Bioacoustic detection
description: Detection or characterization of organisms or biological activity from emitted or reflected acoustic signals.
notes: Candidate biological observation method.

label: Broadband total radiometry
description: Measurement of total broadband irradiance integrated over both shortwave and longwave spectral regions.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 7 "Measurement of radiation" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Campbell–Stokes burn method
description: Sunshine duration is determined by evaluating the burnt areas imprinted by the sun in a strip of carton or aluminum foil placed behind a glass sphere.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Capacitive precipitation detection
description: Detection of liquid precipitation from changes in capacitance caused by the dielectric effect of water on a sensing surface.
descriptionSource: Sensors and Actuators A, capacitive rain sensing principle — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0925400505005721

label: Capacitive pressure measurement
description: Determination of pressure from pressure-induced changes in electrical capacitance.
notes: Common pressure-transduction principle not explicit in the current lists.

label: Chemical-ionization mass spectrometry with matrix isolation
description: Mass-spectrometric determination after selective gas-phase ion–molecule chemical ionization, with matrix isolation used to trap or stabilize products before analysis.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "chemical ionization" in mass spectrometry — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/C01026; matrix-isolation component retained from the WMO legacy term
legacyLabels: Chemical ionization MS (CIMS) with matrix isolation

label: Chemiluminescence detection
description: Detection based on light emitted by a chemical reaction.
legacyMappings: Atmosphere:186; Atmosphere:270; Atmosphere:287; Atmosphere:288; Atmosphere:289; Atmosphere:290; Atmosphere:291
legacyLabels: Regener Sonde (chemiluminescence); Tetrachloromercurate (TCM) absorption - CL; Catalytic conversion 'Au' - CL; Catalytic conversion 'Fe' - CL; Catalytic conversion 'Mb' - CL; Chemiluminescence (CL) [general]; Photolytic conversion - CL
notes: Consolidates 7 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: rename, split.

label: Cloud-condensation-nuclei counting
description: Counting aerosol particles that activate into cloud droplets at a controlled water-vapour supersaturation. Note: also referred to as CCN counting.
descriptionSource: WMO/GAW Report No. 227, WMO/GAW Aerosol Measurement Procedures, Guidelines and Recommendations, 2nd ed. (2016) — https://wmo-gaw-sag-aerosol.org/wmo-gaw-reports.html

label: ANSA colorimetry
description: Colorimetric determination based on formation of a molybdenum-blue complex reduced by 1-amino-2-naphthol-4-sulfonic acid. Note: ANSA is also referred to as aminonaphtholsulfonic acid reagent.
descriptionSource: Environment Canada / Global Environment Monitoring System (GEMS), Analytical Methods Manual, ANSA colorimetry — https://www.waterandchange.org/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Analytical-Methods-GEMS-2014.pdf

label: NEDA colorimetry
description: Colorimetric determination in which nitrite is diazotized and coupled with N-(1-naphthyl)ethylenediamine to form an azo dye; nitrate may first be reduced to nitrite.
descriptionSource: ISO 6777:1984, Water quality — Determination of nitrite — Molecular absorption spectrometric method — https://www.iso.org/standard/13273.html

label: Composite radiosonde tracking
description: Determination of radiosonde position or upper-air wind by combining two or more tracking techniques.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 13 "Measurement of upper wind" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Condensation-particle counting
description: Counting of particles after condensational growth to optically detectable size.

label: Conductive heat-flux measurement
description: Determination of conductive heat flux from the temperature difference across a material of known thermal conductance.
descriptionSource: Vadose Zone Journal, heat-flux plate measurement — https://acsess.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.2136/vzj2003.5890

label: Continuous gravimetry
description: Continuous determination of mass or mass change with time, typically to quantify accumulated, deposited, or removed material.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "gravimetry" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/09043

label: Contrast evaluation and scanning
description: Sunshine duration is determined by combining multi-sensor detectors with an electronic discriminator.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Coulometry
description: Electrochemical determination based on the total electric charge consumed or produced by a reaction.
notes: Common analytical method absent from the current lists.

label: Current velocimetry
description: Generic determination of water-current velocity when the specific sensing principle is not stated.

label: Differential-mobility particle sizing
description: Determination of aerosol particle-size distribution by classifying charged particles according to electrical mobility and detecting the classified fraction.
descriptionSource: ISO 15900, Determination of particle size distribution — Differential electrical mobility analysis for aerosol particles — https://www.iso.org/obp/ui?_escaped_fragment_=iso%3Astd%3Aiso%3A15900%3Aed-2%3Av1%3Aen

label: Differential optical absorption spectroscopy
description: Spectroscopic determination based on wavelength-dependent differential optical absorption.
legacyLabels: SAOZ (UV-vis diode array spectrometer); Differential optical absorption (DOAS)
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Differential ultraviolet absorption spectrophotometry
description: Determination of a constituent amount from differential absorption of ultraviolet radiation at selected wavelengths.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: merge, rename.

label: Diffusion-battery particle sizing
description: Determination of submicrometre particle size from size-dependent Brownian diffusion and deposition during passage through successive diffusion stages.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "diffusion battery" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/D01718

label: Disdrometry
description: Determination of hydrometeor size, fall speed or related precipitation characteristics from individual particles or drops.

label: Dissipation method
description: Estimation of turbulent fluxes from dissipation rates inferred from inertial-subrange fluctuations of wind or scalar quantities.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, sections addressing turbulent-flux measurement methods — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Elastic-backscatter lidar
description: Remote sensing from the range-resolved intensity of laser light elastically backscattered by atmospheric molecules and particles.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. III, Ch. 5 "Special profiling techniques for the boundary layer and the troposphere" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Electrical-mobility classification
description: Classification of charged aerosol particles by balancing electrical force and aerodynamic drag so that particles are selected according to electrical mobility.
descriptionSource: ISO 15900, Determination of particle size distribution — Differential electrical mobility analysis for aerosol particles — https://www.iso.org/obp/ui?_escaped_fragment_=iso%3Astd%3Aiso%3A15900%3Aed-2%3Av1%3Aen

label: Electrochemical concentration-cell measurement
description: Electrochemical determination of concentration using a concentration cell in which the measurand produces a measurable electrical response.

label: Environmental DNA analysis
description: Detection or characterization of organisms from DNA recovered from environmental samples.
notes: DNA remains uppercase as a retained established acronym; definition of sampling versus analytical method needs review.

label: Faraday-cup photochemistry
description: Photochemical measurement in which photo-generated charged particles or ions are collected in a Faraday cup and quantified from the resulting electric current.
descriptionSource: WMO WMDR legacy ObservingMethodAtmosphere register (source term only). No sufficiently authoritative definition located in WMO-No. 8 or a major international glossary/standard; proposed wording is an interpretive synthesis — https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Filter radiometry
description: Radiometric measurement in one or more spectral bands selected by optical filters.

label: Flow cytometry
description: Measurement and classification of particles or cells in a flowing stream from optical or other detector responses.
notes: Candidate biological and water-quality method.

label: Flume discharge measurement
description: Determination of discharge from the hydraulic relation between flow and stage in a calibrated flume.

label: Fluorescence measurement
description: Determination based on light emitted by a substance following excitation.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: rename, split.

label: Flux-variance method
description: Estimation of turbulent fluxes from variances of meteorological scalars or velocity using similarity relationships between variance and flux.
descriptionSource: Journal of Geophysical Research, flux-variance method — https://agupubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1029/2004JD004767

label: Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy
description: Infrared spectroscopy in which an interferogram is transformed mathematically to obtain the spectrum.
legacyLabels: Fourier-transform IR spectroscopy (FTIR); TCCON Fourier-transform IR spectroscopy (TCCON-FTIR)
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: merge, rename.

label: Gas chromatography with electron-capture detection and mass spectrometry
description: Gas-chromatographic separation followed by electron-capture detection and mass-spectrometric detection or identification.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Gas chromatography with HgO reduction and ultraviolet absorption
description: Gas-chromatographic separation followed by a mercury(II)-oxide reduction step and quantification by ultraviolet absorption associated with the reduction product.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Gradient method
description: Estimation of vertical turbulent flux from the measured vertical gradient of a scalar and an appropriate turbulent transfer coefficient.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. III, Ch. 9 "Urban observations" (profile-gradient flux methods) — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Graduated-scale measurement
description: Direct manual determination of a quantity by reading a calibrated graduated scale.

label: Graduated-scale precipitation measurement
description: Determination of collected precipitation depth or amount by direct reading against a graduated length or volume scale.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 6 "Measurement of precipitation" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Graduated-scale water-level measurement
description: Direct determination of water level by reading a calibrated vertical or inclined scale.
notes: Consolidates 3 legacy entries.

label: Gran colorimetric titration
description: Titration in which the equivalence point is obtained by linearizing and extrapolating a transformed titration response according to the Gran method. Note: Gran titration is not intrinsically colorimetric.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "titrimetric analysis" (general principle); Gran endpoint evaluation: USGS, Theoretical considerations and a simple method for measuring alkalinity and acidity in low-pH waters — https://www.usgs.gov/publications/theoretical-considerations-and-a-simple-method-measuring-alkalinity-and-acidity-low-ph

label: Gravimetric precipitation measurement
description: Determination of accumulated precipitation from the measured mass of collected precipitation.

label: Gravimetric snow-water-equivalent measurement
description: Determination of snow water equivalent from the measured mass of the snow cover over a known area.

label: Hygrometry
description: Determination of the water-vapour content or humidity of a gas from a specified physical or chemical response.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 4 "Measurement of humidity" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Inductive conductivity measurement
description: Determination of electrical conductivity from inductive or electromagnetic coupling without direct conductive electrodes.

label: Infrared radiometry
description: Radiometric measurement in the infrared spectral region.
legacyLabels: Pyranometer (measurement of IR radiation); Pyrgeometer (global, infrared)
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: merge, rename.

label: Infrared spectroradiometry
description: Measurement of spectral radiometric quantities as a function of wavelength in the infrared region.
descriptionSource:
WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 7 "Measurement of radiation" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8
Secondary: CIE 250:2022, Spectroradiometric measurement of optical radiation sources — https://www.cie.co.at/publications/spectroradiometric-measurement-optical-radiation-sources

label: Interferometry
description: Determination of optical path difference, phase, displacement, or a related measurand from the interference of coherent waves.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, interferometry/interferometer terminology — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/08622

label: Ion chromatography
description: Chromatographic separation and determination of ionic species.
legacyMappings: Atmosphere:137; Atmosphere:222; Atmosphere:281; Atmosphere:283; Atmosphere:292; Atmosphere:304
legacyLabels: Ion Chromatography (IC) [general]; Monitor for AeRosols and GAses (MARGA); Filter sampling + combustion + IC; Filter sampling + extraction + IC; Monitor for AeRosols and GAses (MARGA) Metrohm; H2O2 conversion - IC
notes: Consolidates 6 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: merge, rename, split.

label: Laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy
description: Elemental spectroscopic analysis based on optical emission from a laser-induced plasma.
notes: Widely used environmental and remote analytical spectroscopy method absent from the current lists.

label: Light-attenuation photometry
description: Photometric determination based on attenuation of light by a sample or collected material.
legacyLabels: Filter + light attenuation (aethalometer); Particle soot absorption photometry (PSAP)
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: merge, split.

label: Liquid-column pressure measurement
description: Determination of pressure from the height of a non-mercury liquid column.

label: Lithium-chloride hygrometry
description: Determination of water-vapour pressure from the equilibrium temperature of a heated saturated lithium-chloride solution, with its electrical conductance used to control the heating. Note: also referred to as lithium-chloride dew-cell hygrometry.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 4 "Measurement of humidity" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Long-path absorption photometry
description: Determination of trace-gas concentration after selective chemical conversion to an absorbing species measured photometrically over a long optical path. Note: also referred to as LOPAP.
descriptionSource: Atmospheric Measurement Techniques, Long Path Absorption Photometer principle — https://amt.copernicus.org/articles/4/1663/2011/index.html

label: Lyman-alpha fluorescence hygrometry
description: Detection of UV fluorescence signal emitted by the excited OH radical produced from H2O after dissociation using UV light.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Lysimetry
description: Determination of water balance components from changes in mass or water content of a defined soil or vegetation volume.

label: Manual water-level measurement
description: Manual determination of water level using a non-recording reference or gauge.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Maximum-stage mark measurement
description: Determination of the elevation of the flood crest by the adherence of regranulated cork to a graduated staff held in a fixed position with relation to the datum. [Based on 'maximum-stage gauge' in Guide to Hydrological Practices (WMO-No. 168), Volume I. 2008 edition, updated in 2020.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Membrane-polarographic oxygen measurement
description: Determination of dissolved oxygen by membrane-separated polarographic electrochemical measurement.

label: Microbarometry
description: Measurement of small atmospheric pressure variations.

label: Microscopy
description: Observation and measurement of structures or organisms using magnified optical, electron or scanning-probe imaging.
notes: Candidate biological/chemical method for a domain-independent list.

label: Microwave radiometry
description: Determination of a measurand from naturally emitted or transmitted microwave radiation.
notes: Consolidates 4 legacy entries.

label: Molecular assay
description: Detection or quantification of biological or chemical targets using molecular recognition, amplification or sequence-based techniques.
notes: Broad candidate parent method; likely requires narrower concepts before adoption.

label: Navigation-aid radiosonde tracking
description: Determination of radiosonde position and upper-air wind from radio-navigation signals received or relayed by the radiosonde. Note: historically includes systems such as LORAN-C and VLF-Omega.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 13 "Measurement of upper wind" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Neutron-moderation moisture measurement
description: Measurement of the moisture content and hence the porosity of a geological formation by means of lowering a tool containing a radioactive element emitting neutrons and a neutron detector into a borehole. [Based on 'neutron logging' in International Glossary of Hydrology (WMO-No. 385). 2012 edition.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Optical attenuation measurement
description: Determination of a property from attenuation of visible or near-visible optical radiation through a medium.

label: Optical backscatter measurement
description: Determination of a property from the intensity of light scattered back toward the source or detector.
legacyLabels: Aerosol backscatter sonde; Fluorometry, optical backscattering
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: rename, split.

label: Optical hygrometry
description: Determination of water-vapour amount from attenuation of optical radiation in water-vapour absorption lines or bands. Note: also referred to as spectral hygrometry.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 4 "Measurement of humidity" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Optical particle counting
description: Counting and, where applicable, sizing of particles from their optical scattering or extinction signals.

label: Pan evaporation measurement
description: Determination of evaporation from the change in water level or volume in an exposed pan or tank.

label: Photogrammetry
description: Determination of geometric or physical properties from measurements in one or more images.
notes: Domain-independent image-based measurement method.

label: Piezoresistive pressure measurement
description: Determination of pressure from the change in electrical resistance of a material or transducer under mechanical stress.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Platinum resistance thermometry
description: Determination of temperature from the calibrated electrical resistance of a platinum sensing element.
notes: Widely used reference-quality and operational temperature method; narrower than generic resistance thermometry.

label: Point-gauge water-level measurement
description: Level measurement gauge, the essential element of which is a pointed rod that is lowered until it touches the water surface. [International Glossary of Hydrology (WMO-No. 385). 2012 edition.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Polarimetric radar
description: Radar measurement using differences in the polarization state of transmitted and received electromagnetic radiation.
notes: Important modern radar method distinct from generic radar and Doppler velocity measurement.

label: Potassium-iodide electrochemical ozone measurement
description: Electrochemical ozone measurement based on reaction of ozone with aqueous potassium iodide in an ozonesonde-type cell.
legacyLabels: Brewer-GDR; Brewer-Mast Sonde; Carbon-Iodine Sonde (KC Sonde); Indian Sonde
notes: Consolidates 4 legacy entries.

label: Potassium-iodide ozone measurement
description: Determination of ozone by oxidation of iodide in potassium-iodide solution and quantification of the iodine produced, commonly by an electrochemical response.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Potentiometry
description: Electrochemical determination of a measurand from the electrical potential difference between an indicator electrode or sensor and a reference electrode.
legacyLabels: Potentiometry (ion-selective electrode); Potentiometry (pH meter); Potentiometric method
notes: Consolidates 3 legacy entries.

label: Pressure-plate anemometry
description: Determination of wind speed from the force or deflection produced by wind pressure on an exposed plate.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 5 "Measurement of surface wind" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Pressure-tube anemometry
description: Determination of wind speed from pressure differences generated by airflow at pressure-tube openings. Note: related to Pitot-static measurement.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 5 "Measurement of surface wind" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Propeller velocity measurement
description: Determination of fluid velocity from the rotation rate of a propeller or vane rotor aligned with the flow.
legacyLabels: Aerovane (wind vane with propeller); Propeller anemometer; Propeller-type current meter
notes: Consolidates 3 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: merge, split.

label: Psychrometry
description: Determination of humidity from paired temperature measurements, commonly dry-bulb and ventilated wet-bulb temperatures.

label: Quantum-cascade-laser spectroscopy
description: Laser-absorption spectroscopy using a tunable quantum-cascade laser, typically in the mid-infrared, to measure species-specific molecular absorption lines. Note: also referred to as QCL spectroscopy.
descriptionSource: Atmospheric Environment, quantum-cascade-laser absorption spectroscopy — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1352231024001857

label: Radar profiling
description: Determination of a vertical or slanted profile from radar returns.

label: Radar remote sensing
description: Remote sensing using transmitted radio-frequency electromagnetic radiation and analysis of the returned signal.

label: Radiochemical methods
description: Analytical methods in which radioactivity or radionuclide behaviour is an essential part of separation, identification, or quantitative determination. Note: also referred to as radioanalytical methods.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "analytical radiochemistry" (radioanalytical chemistry) — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/A00338

label: Resistance-based moisture measurement
description: Determination of electrical resistance between two electrodes embedded in blocks of a porous material buried in the ground and in equilibrium with the surrounding moist soil. [Based on 'porous blocks/electrical resistance blocks' in Guide to Hydrological Practices (WMO-No. 168), Volume II. 2009 edition.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Resonant pressure measurement
description: Determination of pressure from pressure-induced changes in the resonant frequency of a mechanical or acoustic element.
notes: Common modern pressure-transduction principle.

label: Rotating-cup velocity measurement
description: Determination of fluid velocity from the rotation rate of a cup rotor exposed to the flow.
legacyLabels: Cup anemometer; Cup anemometer (3 or 4 cups); Cup-type current meter
notes: Consolidates 3 legacy entries.

label: Satellite-navigation atmospheric-delay measurement
description: Determination of atmospheric properties from propagation delays in signals from navigation satellites.
notes: Covers atmospheric water-vapour and related retrievals without embedding a particular navigation-system acronym.

label: Satellite-navigation position differencing
description: Determination of displacement or velocity from differences between successive satellite-navigation position fixes.

label: Satellite-navigation reflectometry
description: Determination of surface or near-surface properties from reflected signals transmitted by navigation satellites.
notes: Modern remote-sensing method applicable across ocean, cryosphere, land and atmosphere.

label: Satellite radio occultation
description: Determination of atmospheric or ionospheric properties from changes in a radio signal as the propagation path passes through the limb of a planetary atmosphere.
notes: Important profiling method not explicit in the current observing-method tables.

label: Scanning-mobility particle sizing
description: Determination of aerosol particle-size distribution by scanning the electrical-mobility selection voltage and counting particles in successive mobility classes. Note: also referred to as SMPS.
descriptionSource: ISO 15900, Determination of particle size distribution — Differential electrical mobility analysis for aerosol particles — https://www.iso.org/obp/ui?_escaped_fragment_=iso%3Astd%3Aiso%3A15900%3Aed-2%3Av1%3Aen

label: Scatterometry
description: Visual range is calculated by measuring the return of light beam scattered by diffusion in air.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Scintillation counting
description: Determination of ionizing-radiation events from light pulses produced in a scintillating material.

label: Separation and manometric determination
description: Determination of a gas quantity after selective separation by measuring the pressure of the isolated gas in a known volume under specified temperature conditions.
descriptionSource: WMO WMDR legacy ObservingMethodAtmosphere register (source term only). No sufficiently authoritative definition located in WMO-No. 8 or a major international glossary/standard; proposed wording is an interpretive synthesis — https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Sound detection and ranging profiling
description: Profiling by transmission and reception of acoustic signals in the atmosphere.

label: Sun photometry
description: Photometric measurement of direct solar radiation, typically in selected spectral bands.
notes: Consolidates 4 legacy entries.

label: Surface-chamber flux measurement
description: Determination of a surface-atmosphere flux from accumulation, depletion or flow through a chamber enclosing a defined surface area.

label: Tensiometric soil-water-potential measurement
description: Measurement of soil capillary tension by means of a porous cup, inserted in the soil, connected to a manometer by a water-filled tube. [Based on 'tensiometer' in International Glossary of Hydrology (WMO-No. 385). 2012 edition.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Thermal-diffusion cloud activation measurement
description: Determination of cloud-condensation-nuclei activity by exposing aerosol to a controlled supersaturation generated by a temperature gradient and counting activated droplets.
descriptionSource: WMO/GAW Report No. 227, WMO/GAW Aerosol Measurement Procedures, Guidelines and Recommendations, 2nd ed. (2016) — https://wmo-gaw-sag-aerosol.org/wmo-gaw-reports.html

label: Thermoelectric measurement
description: Determination of temperature or heat flux from a thermoelectric voltage generated by a temperature difference between dissimilar conductors. Note: includes thermocouples and thermopiles.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 2 "Measurement of temperature" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Thermoelectric thermometry
description: Determination of temperature from thermoelectric voltage generated by a junction or junction pair.
notes: Provides a method-level concept for thermocouple temperature observations.

label: Thermometry
description: Measurement of temperature without specifying a narrower sensing principle.

label: Thermo-optical analysis
description: Thermal analysis combined with optical monitoring to separate or quantify sample components.

label: Tunable infrared laser differential-absorption spectroscopy (TILDAS)
description: Tunable Infrared Laser Differential Absorption Spectroscopy (TILDAS).
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere
legacyLabels: Tunable Infrared Laser Differential Absorption Spectroscopy (TILDAS)

label: Tipping-bucket precipitation measurement
description: Determination of precipitation amount by counting repeated tips of a calibrated bucket after fixed increments of collected water.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 6 "Measurement of precipitation" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Visual wind estimation
description: Visual estimation of wind direction and approximate speed from the orientation and extension of a wind sock or similar aerodynamic indicator.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 5 "Measurement of surface wind" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Volumetric measurement
description: A process for measuring the discharge of a well, spring, or stream by diverting its flow into a volumetric container and timing the fill.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere; Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Weir discharge measurement
description: Determination of discharge from the hydraulic relation between head and flow at a calibrated weir.

label: Wet-chemical methods
description: Analytical methods in which the measurand is determined through chemical reactions carried out in solution, with a physical or chemical endpoint or detection step.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Wind-vane direction measurement
description: Determination of wind direction from the equilibrium orientation of a freely rotating vane aligned by aerodynamic torque.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 5 "Measurement of surface wind" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8
legacyLabels: Aerovane (wind vane with propeller); Wind vane (solid blade)
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: rename, split.

label: Wire-weight water-level measurement
description: Determination of water stage by means of a fine cable or wire attached to a weight which is lowered to the water surface in order to determine its position below a fixed above-surface point. [Based on 'wire weight gauge' in International Glossary of Hydrology (WMO-No. 385). 2012 edition.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: X-ray attenuation measurement
description: Determination of a property from attenuation of X-radiation through a medium.

label: Acoustic-Doppler velocimetry
description: Determination of fluid velocity from the Doppler shift of acoustic signals scattered by material moving with the fluid.
legacyLabels: Acoustic doppler current meter; Acoustic doppler velocity meter (ADVM)
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Alpha counting
description: Counting of alpha-particle events.
legacyLabels: Alpha counting; Filter sampling + alpha counting; Electrostatic collection + alpha counting
notes: Consolidates 3 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: rename, split.

label: Aneroid pressure measurement
description: Determination of pressure from elastic deformation of an evacuated or partially evacuated capsule.

label: Atomic absorption spectrophotometry
description: Determination of elemental amount from absorption of characteristic electromagnetic radiation by free atoms in the vapour phase.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "atomic absorption spectroscopy" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/08451

label: Atomic emission spectrophotometry
description: Determination of elemental composition from characteristic electromagnetic radiation emitted by excited atoms or ions.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "atomic emission spectroscopy" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/08452

label: Backscatter lidar
description: Lidar measurement based on detection of radiation backscattered from the atmosphere or another medium.

label: Bed-material-discharge rating relation
description: An empirical relationship relating bed-material discharge and streamflow based on correlation analysis of sediment samples and concurrent flow estimates and presented as a curve, table, or equation. [Based on 'sediment rating curve' in Guide to Hydrological Practices (WMO-No. 168), Volume I. 2008 edition, updated in 2020.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Beta attenuation
description: Determination of collected particulate mass from attenuation of beta radiation.

label: Beta counting
description: Counting of beta-particle events.

label: Bimetallic thermometry
description: Determination of temperature from differential thermal expansion of bonded metals.

label: Boiling-point hypsometry
description: Determination of pressure or elevation from the boiling temperature of a liquid.

label: Bowen-ratio method
description: Estimation of sensible and latent heat fluxes from the ratio of vertical temperature and water-vapour gradients, usually combined with the surface energy balance.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 10 "Measurement of evaporation" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Capacitive humidity measurement
description: Determination of humidity from changes in electrical capacitance of a humidity-sensitive material.

label: Capillary electrophoresis
description: Separation of charged species in a capillary according to differences in electrophoretic mobility under an applied electric field.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "capillary electrophoresis" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/09913

label: Cavity-enhanced absorption spectroscopy
description: Absorption spectroscopy in which a high-reflectivity optical cavity increases the effective optical path length through the sample.
descriptionSource: NERC Vocabulary Server (SeaDataNet/BODC), "broadband cavity-enhanced absorption spectroscopy" — https://vocab.nerc.ac.uk/collection/S04/current/S041028/

label: Cavity ring-down spectroscopy
description: Absorption spectroscopy in which absorption is derived from the decay time of light circulating in a high-reflectivity optical cavity.
descriptionSource: NERC Vocabulary Server (SeaDataNet/BODC), "cavity ring-down spectrometry" — https://vocab.nerc.ac.uk/collection/S04/current/S041071/

label: Chilled-mirror hygrometry
description: Determination of dew- or frost-point temperature by controlling a reflective surface at the onset of condensation or frost.

label: Colorimetric titration
description: Titration in which the endpoint is determined from a colour change or photometric response of an indicator or reaction product.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "titration" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/T06387

label: Colorimetry
description: Chemical determination based on measurement of colour or optical absorbance produced by a reaction.

label: Differential-absorption lidar
description: Light detection and ranging (lidar) with differential absorption lidar (DIAL) capability, typically used for trace gas measurements, most notably ozone and water vapor. This technique can be extended to molecules which have suitably defined differential absorption characteristics.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Dilution gauging
description: Determination of discharge from dilution of an introduced tracer.

label: Direct-solar radiometry
description: Radiometric measurement of direct-beam solar irradiance.

label: Disjunct eddy covariance
description: Determination of turbulent scalar flux from the covariance of vertical-wind fluctuations with intermittently sampled scalar concentrations.
descriptionSource: AMS Glossary of Meteorology, "disjunct eddy covariance" — https://glossary.ametsoc.org/wiki/disjunct-eddy-covariance/

label: Doppler wind lidar
description: Light detection and ranging (lidar) with Doppler capability (direct and coherent mode), typically used for measurements of winds.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Echo sounding
description: Evaluation of the return time of acoustic waves emitted into a medium to determine the distance between source and target. This method is used in hydrology, for example, to determine the depth of a water body. [Based on 'echo sounder' in International Glossary of Hydrology (WMO-No. 385). 2012 edition.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Eddy accumulation
description: Determination of turbulent scalar flux by separately accumulating updraft and downdraft air according to vertical velocity and comparing their scalar concentrations.
descriptionSource: AMS Glossary of Meteorology, "eddy accumulation" — https://glossary.ametsoc.org/wiki/eddy-accumulation/

label: Eddy covariance
description: Determination of turbulent flux as the time covariance of vertical-wind fluctuations with fluctuations of the transported scalar or momentum component.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 10 "Measurement of evaporation" and Vol. III, Ch. 9 "Urban observations" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Electrical conductivity measurement
description: Determination of the electrical conductivity of a medium from its electrical response.
legacyLabels: Conductometry; Electric conductivity (EC meter); Electrical conductivity
notes: Consolidates 3 legacy entries.

label: Electrical-mobility analysis
description: Determination or classification of charged-particle size from electrical mobility.

label: Electrical resistivity measurement
description: Determination of electrical resistivity of a medium.

label: Electromagnetic velocimetry
description: Determination of conductive-fluid velocity from an electromotive response generated by motion through a magnetic field.

label: Filter sun photometry
description: Sun photometry in discrete spectral bands selected by optical filters.

label: Flame-ionization detection
description: Detection of organic compounds from the ion current produced when sample components are burned in a hydrogen flame.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "flame-ionization detector" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/F02410

label: Float gauging
description: Determination of stream velocity from the transit time of a float or velocity rod.

label: Float water-level measurement
description: Determination of water level from the position of a float that follows the water surface.

label: Flow-injection analysis
description: Chemical analysis in which a sample is injected into a flowing carrier stream and transported to a detector.

label: Frequency-domain reflectometry
description: Determination of dielectric properties from the response of a medium to radio-frequency excitation in the frequency domain.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Gamma-ray attenuation
description: Determination of a property from attenuation of gamma radiation through a medium.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Gamma spectrometry
description: Spectrometric determination of gamma radiation as a function of photon energy.

label: Gas chromatography
description: Chromatographic separation in which the mobile phase is a gas.
legacyLabels: Adsorption tube (charcoal) + elution + GC; Gas Chromatography (GC) [general]
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: rename, split.

label: Gas chromatography with cold-vapour atomic fluorescence spectrometry
description: Gas chromatography and detection by cold vapour atomic fluorescence spectrometry.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Gas chromatography with electron-capture detection
description: Gas-chromatographic separation followed by detection of electronegative compounds from their reduction of an electron-capture detector current.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Gas chromatography with electron-capture and flame-ionization detection
description: Gas-chromatographic separation followed by electron-capture and flame-ionization detection.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Gas chromatography with flame-ionization detection
description: Gas-chromatographic separation followed by flame-ionization detection through the ion current produced in a hydrogen flame.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Gas chromatography–mass spectrometry
description: Gas-chromatographic separation of mixture components followed by mass-spectrometric detection and identification.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Gas chromatography with thermal-conductivity detection
description: Gas chromatography with detection by changes in thermal conductivity.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Gas-filter-correlation infrared absorption
description: Infrared absorption measurement using gas-filter correlation.

label: Global-solar radiometry
description: Radiometric measurement of global short-wave solar irradiance.

label: Gravimetric moisture determination
description: Measurement of the amount of water in soil by weighing a sample before and after drying it in an oven at a temperature of 100-110 degrees Celsius. [Based on 'gravimetric method' in International Glossary of Hydrology (WMO-No. 385). 2012 edition.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Gravimetric sediment measurement
description: Estimation of the total sediment in a water sample by allowing the sediment to settle in a container, siphoning off the supernatant water, carefully transferring all the sediment from the container on to filter paper, then drying the sample and determining the mass of total sediment. [Based on 'gravimetric method' in International Glossary of Hydrology (WMO-No. 385). 2012 edition.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Gravimetry
description: Quantitative determination based on measurement of mass, usually after separating, collecting, or otherwise isolating the measurand in a weighable form.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "gravimetry" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/09043
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries. Legacy dispositions: rename, split.

label: Griess colorimetry
description: Colorimetric determination of nitrite based on diazotization followed by azo-dye formation with an aromatic coupling reagent. Note: commonly referred to as the Griess reaction.
descriptionSource: ISO 6777:1984, Water quality — Determination of nitrite — Molecular absorption spectrometric method — https://www.iso.org/standard/13273.html

label: Hair hygrometry
description: Determination of humidity from dimensional changes of hygroscopic hair or a similar organic element.

label: High-frequency-radar Doppler spectral analysis
description: Determination of surface-current properties from Doppler spectra of high-frequency radar echoes.
legacyLabels: HF echo Doppler spectra analysis method (HR radar)

label: High-performance liquid chromatography
description: Liquid-chromatographic separation using a packed column operated under elevated pressure to resolve sample components.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "liquid chromatography" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/L03578

label: High-spectral-resolution lidar
description: Lidar method that spectrally separates molecular and particulate backscatter to retrieve optical properties.

label: Hot-wire anemometry
description: Determination of fluid velocity from heat transfer from an electrically heated wire or element.

label: Hydrostatic-pressure water-level measurement
description: Determination of water level from hydrostatic pressure at a known reference elevation.

label: Image velocimetry
description: Determination of velocity from the displacement of identifiable image patterns or particles between successive images.

label: Index-velocity discharge method
description: Determination of discharge from an established relation between index velocity, mean velocity, stage and cross-sectional area.

label: Indophenol (Berthelot) colorimetry
description: Colorimetric determination of ammonia or ammonium through formation of an indophenol dye after reaction with hypochlorite and a phenolic reagent under alkaline conditions. Note: also referred to as the Berthelot or phenate method.
descriptionSource: ISO 7150-1:1984, Water quality — Determination of ammonium — Part 1: Manual spectrometric method — https://www.iso.org/standard/13742.html

label: Inductively coupled plasma atomic-emission spectrometry
description: Determination of elemental composition by exciting and ionizing atoms in an inductively coupled plasma and measuring their characteristic emitted radiation. Note: also referred to as ICP-OES.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "inductively coupled plasma optical-emission spectrometry" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/08491; see also ISO 11885:2007 — https://www.iso.org/standard/36250.html

label: Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry
description: Determination of elemental or isotopic composition by ionization in an inductively coupled plasma followed by mass-spectrometric separation and detection.
descriptionSource:
WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8
Secondary: IUPAC Gold Book, "inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/08490

label: Infrared-absorption hygrometry
description: Determination of water-vapour amount from absorption of infrared radiation.

label: Integrated-cavity-output spectroscopy
description: Absorption spectroscopy in which light makes many passes through a high-reflectivity cavity and absorption is derived from the time-integrated transmitted intensity. Note: also referred to as ICOS.
descriptionSource: NERC Vocabulary Server (SeaDataNet/BODC), "cavity enhanced absorption spectrometers" (explicitly includes integrated cavity output spectroscopy, ICOS) — https://vocab.nerc.ac.uk/collection/L05/current/LAB38/

label: Integrated-path differential-absorption lidar
description: Light detection and ranging (lidar) with integrated path differential absorption (IPDA) capability, typically used for column measurements of CH4 and CO2.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Integrating nephelometry
description: Determination of light-scattering properties by collecting scattered light over a broad angular range.

label: Laser-induced fluorescence
description: Detection or quantification of species from fluorescence emitted after selective excitation by laser radiation. Note: also referred to as LIF.
descriptionSource: NERC Vocabulary Server (SeaDataNet/BODC), analytical method "laser-induced fluorescence" — https://vocab.nerc.ac.uk/collection/S04/current/S041027/

label: Laser photoacoustic spectroscopy
description: Photoacoustic spectroscopy using a laser source, in which absorbed modulated radiation is converted through non-radiative relaxation into an acoustic signal.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "photoacoustic spectroscopy" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/P04576

label: Laser ranging
description: Emission of a modulated beam of light in the visible spectrum to determine the distance to a target by comparing the phase information from the reflected beam.
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Laser spectroscopy
description: Spectroscopic determination using laser radiation as the optical source.

label: Light-absorption photometry
description: Photometric determination based on absorption of light by a sample.

label: Light scattering
description: Determination of particle or molecular properties from the intensity, angular distribution, or spectrum of light redirected by interaction with the sample.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 9 "Measurement of visibility" and Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Liquid-column thermometry
description: Determination of temperature from the thermally induced change in the level or volume of a calibrated non-mercury liquid column.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Mass-balance method
description: Determination or consistency checking based on conservation of mass by accounting for the mass of a specified substance or element across defined forms, pathways, or system boundaries.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "mass balance" in atmospheric chemistry — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/M03712

label: Mass spectrometry
description: Determination based on separation and detection of ions according to mass-to-charge ratio.

label: Mercury-column pressure measurement
description: Determination of pressure from the height of a mercury column.

label: Mercury-column thermometry
description: Determination of temperature from the thermally induced change in the level or volume of mercury in a calibrated liquid column.
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Mercury-thiocyanate colorimetry
description: Colorimetric determination of halides, especially chloride, by liberation of thiocyanate from mercury(II) thiocyanate and formation of a coloured iron–thiocyanate complex.
descriptionSource: ISO 5793:1978, Sulphur for industrial use — Determination of chloride content — Photometric method (historical/withdrawn; documents the mercury-thiocyanate principle) — https://www.iso.org/standard/11932.html

label: Multi-angle absorption photometry
description: Determination of aerosol light absorption from simultaneous measurements of filter transmittance and light scattered at multiple angles, with correction for particle scattering. Note: also referred to as MAAP.
descriptionSource: WMO/GAW Report No. 200, Standard Operating Procedures for In-situ Measurements of Aerosol Mass Concentration, Light Scattering and Light Absorption — https://www.gaw-wdca.org/publications/

label: Nessler colorimetry
description: Colorimetric determination of ammonia from the yellow-to-brown product formed with alkaline tetraiodomercurate(II) reagent. Note: also referred to as Nesslerization.
descriptionSource: WHO, Water Quality Assessments: A Guide to Use of Biota, Sediments and Water in Environmental Monitoring, section on ammonia analysis — https://iris.who.int/handle/10665/41850

label: Non-dispersive infrared absorption
description: Determination of gas concentration from wavelength-selective infrared absorption measured without spectral dispersion, typically using optical filtering or gas correlation. Note: also referred to as NDIR.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Non-dispersive ultraviolet absorption
description: Determination of gas concentration from wavelength-selective ultraviolet absorption measured without spectral dispersion. Note: also referred to as NDUV.
descriptionSource: ISO 7935:2024, Stationary source emissions — Determination of the mass concentration of sulfur dioxide in flue gases — Performance characteristics of automated measuring systems (lists non-dispersive ultraviolet absorption, NDUV, as a measurement principle) — https://www.iso.org/standard/83052.html

label: Optical pilot-balloon tracking
description: Determination of upper-air wind by optically tracking the angular position of a freely rising balloon as a function of time.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 13 "Measurement of upper wind" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Oxygen luminescence quenching
description: Determination of oxygen from the quenching effect of oxygen on the luminescence of an excited indicator.

label: Particle-induced X-ray emission spectrometry
description: Elemental spectrometry based on characteristic X-ray emission induced by energetic charged particles.

label: Photoacoustic detection
description: Detection based on the acoustic signal generated when absorbed modulated radiation is converted to heat and pressure waves.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "photoacoustic spectroscopy" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/P04576

label: Piston pressure-balance measurement
description: Determination of pressure by balancing the pressure force on a piston of known effective area against a known applied force. Note: also referred to as a piston gauge or dead-weight pressure balance.
descriptionSource: OIML R 110:1994, Pressure balances — https://www.oiml.org/en/files/pdf_r/r110-e94.pdf

label: Polarized lidar
description: Lidar measurement using polarization characteristics of transmitted or returned radiation.

label: Proton-transfer-reaction mass spectrometry
description: Mass-spectrometric determination of trace gases after soft chemical ionization by proton transfer, commonly from hydronium ions. Note: also referred to as PTR-MS.
descriptionSource: NERC Vocabulary Server (SeaDataNet/BODC), analytical method "proton transfer reaction mass spectrometry" — https://vocab.nerc.ac.uk/collection/S04/current/S041060/

label: Radar-Doppler velocimetry
description: Determination of surface or target velocity from the Doppler shift of a radar return.

label: Radar radiosonde tracking
description: Determination of radiosonde position and upper-air wind by radar tracking of the balloon, radiosonde, or attached radar target.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 13 "Measurement of upper wind" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Radar ranging
description: Determination of distance from the travel time or phase of a transmitted and returned radar signal.

label: Radio-acoustic sounding
description: Determination of virtual-temperature profiles from the propagation speed of artificially generated acoustic waves measured by Doppler radar. Note: also referred to as a radio-acoustic sounding system (RASS).
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. III, Ch. 5 "Special profiling techniques for the boundary layer and the troposphere" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8
notes: Consolidates 2 legacy entries.

label: Radiometry
description: Measurement of electromagnetic radiant quantities.

label: Radionuclide decay counting
description: Determination of radioactive decay events per unit time.

label: Radiotheodolite radiosonde tracking
description: Determination of radiosonde direction and upper-air wind by tracking its radio transmitter with a directional antenna or radiotheodolite.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 13 "Measurement of upper wind" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Raman lidar
description: Light detection and ranging (lidar) with Raman capability, typically used for measurements of aerosol particle phase and cloud measurements as well as water vapor and temperature.
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Resistance thermometry
description: Determination of temperature from the temperature dependence of electrical resistance.

label: Saltzman colorimetry
description: Colorimetric determination of nitrogen dioxide after absorption and azo-dye formation with sulfanilic-acid/NEDA reagent. Note: also referred to as the Griess–Saltzman method.
descriptionSource: ISO 6768:1998, Ambient air — Determination of mass concentration of nitrogen dioxide — Modified Griess-Saltzman method — https://www.iso.org/standard/13262.html

label: Sediment-discharge rating relation
description: An empirical relationship relating sediment discharge and streamflow based on correlation analysis of sediment samples and concurrent flow estimates and presented as a curve, table, or equation. [Based on 'sediment rating curve' in Guide to Hydrological Practices (WMO-No. 168), Volume I. 2008 edition, updated in 2020.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Sediment displacement measurement
description: Determination of sediment concentration by the measurement of the difference in weight between a sample of sediment-laden water and an equal volume of clear water at the same temperature. [Based on 'displacement method' in Manual on Sediment Management and Measurement (WMO-No. 948). 2003.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Slope-area method
description: Determination of discharge from water-surface slope, channel geometry and hydraulic resistance.

label: Sodium-salicylate colorimetry
description: Colorimetric determination of nitrate based on nitration of salicylate followed by formation of a coloured product under alkaline conditions.
descriptionSource: ISO 787-19:2020, General methods of test for pigments — Part 19: Determination of water-soluble nitrates (Salicylic acid method) — https://www.iso.org/standard/79812.html

label: Spectral-solar radiometry
description: Spectrally resolved radiometric measurement of solar radiation.

label: Stage-discharge relation
description: Determination of discharge from an established relation between water level and discharge.

label: Thorin colorimetry
description: Photometric determination based on the colour response of thorin in a selective chemical reaction, classically used for sulfate after reaction with barium.
descriptionSource: ISO 4221:1980, Air quality — Determination of mass concentration of sulphur dioxide in ambient air — Thorin spectrophotometric method — https://www.iso.org/standard/10015.html

label: Time-domain reflectometry
description: Estimation of water content in unsaturated materials based on variations in their dielectric properties. [International Glossary of Hydrology (WMO-No. 385). 2012 edition.]
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Titration
description: Quantitative determination by adding measured amounts of a titrant that reacts stoichiometrically with the analyte until an endpoint is detected.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, "titration" — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/T06387

label: Transmissometry
description: Determination of optical transmission or attenuation along a defined path.

label: Tunable-diode-laser spectroscopy
description: Tunable diode lase spectroscopy (TDLS)
descriptionSource: Atmosphere: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodAtmosphere

label: Turbidimetry
description: Determination of turbidity from attenuation or scattering of light by suspended material.

label: Ultrasonic ranging
description: Transmission of an ultrasonic pulse towards the target and listening for a return echo from that target.
descriptionSource: Terrestrial: https://codes.wmo.int/wmdr/ObservingMethodTerrestrial

label: Ultraviolet-absorption spectroradiometry
description: Determination of wavelength-resolved ultraviolet absorption from measurements of incident and transmitted spectral radiation.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" (ozone spectrophotometry) — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Ultraviolet fluorescence
description: Determination of a species from fluorescence emitted after excitation with ultraviolet radiation.
descriptionSource: ISO 10498:2004, Ambient air — Determination of sulfur dioxide — Ultraviolet fluorescence method — https://www.iso.org/standard/38904.html

label: Ultraviolet spectroradiometry
description: Measurement of spectral radiometric quantities as a function of wavelength in the ultraviolet region.
descriptionSource:
WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 7 "Measurement of radiation" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8
Secondary: CIE S 017:2020, International Lighting Vocabulary, "spectroradiometer" — https://www.cie.co.at/eilvterm/17-25-007

label: Ultraviolet-visible spectroradiometry
description: Spectrally resolved radiometric measurement in the ultraviolet and visible regions.

label: Umkehr method
description: Retrieval of the vertical ozone distribution from changes in zenith-sky ultraviolet intensity ratios as solar zenith angle changes around sunrise or sunset. Note: also referred to as the Umkehr method.
descriptionSource: WMO-No. 8, Guide to Instruments and Methods of Observation, Vol. I, Ch. 16 "Measurement of atmospheric composition" — https://community.wmo.int/site/knowledge-hub/programmes-and-initiatives/instruments-and-methods-of-observation-programme-imop/guide-instruments-and-methods-of-observation-wmo-no-8

label: Vacuum-ultraviolet fluorescence
description: Determination of a species from fluorescence emitted after excitation with vacuum-ultraviolet radiation. Note: also referred to as VUV fluorescence.
descriptionSource: IUPAC Gold Book, fluorescence — https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/F02453

label: Velocity-area method
description: Determination of discharge from measured flow velocities and elemental areas across a channel cross-section.

label: Visual estimation
description: Determination of an observed property by direct visual assessment.

label: X-ray fluorescence spectrometry
description: Elemental spectrometry based on characteristic X-ray fluorescence.
